name: opencode-science
description: Scientific research workbench capabilities for OpenCode V2: vendored skills, read-only data connectors, notebook execution against the user's own interpreter, and immutable artifact versions with provenance records.

scripts.verify: npm run audit && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run check && npm run check:vendor && npm run install:plugin
scripts.test: python scripts/test-python-effects.py && python scripts/test-r-effects.py && python scripts/test-pdf-extract.py && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/test-identifiers.mjs && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/test-literature.mjs && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/test-review.mjs && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/test-workflow.mjs
